THE WOMAN IN THE NEW AGE
Greetings, my very beloved, dearest friends.  Blessings for every one of you here.  I have
promised to give a lecture tonight about the woman in the new age .  I will do so with joy and great
pleasure.  I shall speak of the evolution of consciousness as it relates to the woman and to the
man-woman relationship.  One cannot discuss this topic without seeing the evolving relat ionship
between the sexes.
As the planet is maturing, so are men and women.  What does this aspect of maturity really
mean?  Where have woman and man come from in the evolutionary movement, and where are they
going?  What is the ultimate realization of womanhood -- and of manhood?  Woman is coming into
her own in this phase of history; she is coming out of her confinement.
At the dawn of mankind, mankind was in a very primitive state of development.  Distrust was
rampant.  Distrust in everything and anything other than the self.  Distrust of the phenomena of
nature, of animals, of the weather, of the gods, of fate, of other tribes -- anything that was different,
strange, foreign, or that seemed that way.  Therefore, of course, distrust of the opposite sex was also
very strong.  Man innately distrusted woman, and woman man.  Each seemed justified in his or her
distrust by dint of the other's distrustful attitude.  Since man was physically the stronger and since
physicality was the sole expression of mankind at its dawn, he also assumed a general aura of
superiority over all who were weaker.
The mutual distrust and man's physical domination were very overtly acted out in these early
periods of humanity.  Since then, to a lesser degree, the same traits and attitudes remained imbedded
in the consciousness of woman and man.  They may be overshadowed by more realistic and mature
awareness.  They may not be acted out in the same way, but there remains a hidden corner in the
psychic substance that needs to be brought out and changed in the course of the total development
of all human beings.  When you look back in history, you can see that the planet did what so many
individuals do -- retaining an attitude long after it is meaningful, or purposeful, or adequate to th e
general development of the entity.  So man retained a position of superiority long after physical
prowess ceased to be considered the prime value.  Other values had come into existence as
development progressed, values that certainly apply equally to both sexes.  Yet, man (and often
women as well) persisted in considering man the superior and woman the inferior.  To justify this
assumption and make it a "fact," woman was supposed to be intellectually and morally weaker.  But
you all know this.
To the degree man did not meet and deal with his own feelings of inferiority and weakness, to
the degree he wished to pretend that he did not have those feelings, he assumed a position of
arrogance and superiority over those who were weaker in physical strength.  He needed slaves in

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 229 (An Unedited Lecture)
Page 2 of 8
order to convince himself of his own value.  This applied to animals, to peoples whom he
conquered and subjugated through warfare, and also to women.  Woman chose later to assume a
mental and emotional position of dependency and thus actively chose enslavement no matter how
much she tried to put the blame exclusively on man.
By the same token, man expressed and evinced fear toward those who were physically
stronger than he.  And the more the fear existed toward those who were stronger, the greater the
urge became to subjugate weaker people.  This is a human trait in the unenlightened person that you
well know from your own inner processes.  It is a compensatory phenomenon.  This attitude still
exists in the consciousness of mankind even today.  It is not something that woman is free of, for
when you look very deeply into your own consciousness, you will find similar attitudes embedded in
yourself.  There is also a part in woman that contributed to the situation in the age that has just
passed.  Why has woman been subjugated and denied her birthright of self -expression, of mental,
emotional, and spiritual equality with the man so long after physical prowess had ceased to be an
individual's main value?  Woman could not simply be a victim to man's egotistical desires to feel
superior and stronger, to possess the woman as an object.  The woman also plays a role here.
You, my friends, who are on this path, no longer find it extremely difficult to ascertain
attitudes in you where you do not want to assume self -responsibility, where you want to be taken
care of by a stronger authority figure.  Again, similar attitudes exist in man.  However, in the old
interrelationship between man and woman, the woman victimized herself by acting out on the level
of outer behavior a denial of self-responsibility.  She acted out giving in to the line of least resistance
so as to be taken care of.  She wanted an authority figure to make decisions for her, to take the
consequences of her mistakes, to take the blame, to take the responsibility, and to battle with the
hardships of life.  She wanted to indulge in the pseudo-comfort of a subjugated state.
It has turned out to be a disappointing, unfulfilling way of life, as all misconceptions sooner or
later must lead to that.  But woman has again abstained from taking her share of the responsibility
for this state of affairs.  Now she puts all the blame on the man.
The new woman's movement contains a great deal of truth, but it is, as in all dualistic
approaches, but a half -truth.  The truth is that woman indeed possesses the same faculties of
intelligence, of resourcefulness, of creativity, of psychic strength, of productive self-expression in life
as the man.  To claim that she does not makes no sense at all and has become a game on the part of
man who does not want to face his own feelings of weakness and inferiority and who therefore
needs to feel superior to woman.
By the same token, woman, in order to make the new women's movement truly meaningful,
must ascertain within herself the part that has invited her enslavement.  I would venture to say, the
stronger the outer rebellion and the blaming of the opposite sex, the stronger must also be within
the soul of that individual woman the desire not to govern her own life, not to be responsible and
take the consequences of her actions and decisions and lean on someone else.  To the degree that
she makes unfair and unrealizable demands, she must resent and blame male authority and play a
game of victimization.
On the other hand, to the degree the man does not face his fears, his guilts and weaknesses,
he will play a power game in one form or another and then resent the woman for exploiting him and

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 229 (An Unedited Lecture)
Page 3 of 8
putting too much of a burden on him.  In the immature soul, both want the advantage without
paying the price:  the man wants the superior position but resents the price of taking care of a
parasite.  The woman wants the advantage of being taken care of, of not standing on her own two
feet, but resents the price of losing her autonomy.  Both play the same game but hesitate to see their
mutual creation in this distortion.
On a still deeper level of the consciousness of man and woman, the opposite of the manifest
behavior also exists.  The man also carries an aspect where he shrinks away from the responsibility
of adulthood and envies the woman her position that was socially sanctioned for her for so long.
He overcompensates for this by too much emphasis on the power game.  The woman hides a part in
her where she, too, wants aggression, power, strength -- not only in the real sense but also in the
distorted sense.  She envies man for it.  In former times, this side of her had to be totally submerged.
It was not sanctioned socially, just as the man's counterpart was rejected.  Only recently has this part
emerged, but it is often still confused with genuine selfhood.  Both men and women must find their
way out of the confusion: how can man be an equal to the woman without being weak?  How can
woman have her emotional fulfillment and still be an autonomous adult?  These are not real
opposites, but results of the dualistic confusion.
When movements, orientations, and philosophies do not deal with the whole picture, but with
only half of the picture, it is impossible to set the balance right.  It will merely become the opposite
imbalance from the one that existed previously.  Although in the course of evolution the pendulum
must swing to some degree from one extreme and exaggeration into its exact opposite, deeper and
wiser insight into the unitive truth can help to avoid excess in this respect.
You know these principles that I have discussed again and again on this path.  One is the
principle of dualism versus the principle of unitive consciousness.  In duality, the man will feel
superior and believe woman to be inferior.  He will consequently exploit her but will also feel
exploited by her.  In such a relationship, fulfillment is impossible.  And the woman will feel that she
is being unfairly put upon and exploited by the physically stronger man and will blame him for being
victimized.  Both will fail to see the other side where they are indeed very similar and where they
complement one another in a distorted way.
I have spoken before about some of the points I have to mention in this lecture.  So once
again I will have to repeat myself.  I have mentioned a long time ago that both the feminine and the
masculine principles must be represented in the healthy individual.  They may not be expressed in
exactly the same way in man and in woman, for the differences make up the whole.  But the
differences are not of a qualitative kind.  They must never lead to a comparative value judgment that
one is better or more developed than the other.
Let us have a glimpse of the woman in the new age.  Let me paint a picture, and then let us
see how this applies to the relationship between the sexes.  The new woman is completely
self-responsible and therefore free.  She stands on her own two feet, not only materially but also
intellectually, mentally, and emotionally.  By that, I mean specifically that she knows that no man can
give her happiness and the pleasure of the flowing feelings unless she herself produces them through
loving and through integrity, through opening her heart to loving and opening her mind to her own
inner truth.  The new woman knows that loving a man and surrendering to her feelings for the man
enhances her strength as an individual.  It does not diminish her strength.  There is no conflict for

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 229 (An Unedited Lecture)
Page 4 of 8
the woman in the new age between being a productive, creative, contributing member of society,
and a loving mate.  There is not only no conflict whatsoever, but, in fact, real love is not possible
toward someone to whom one plays a slave in order to abdicate one's self -responsibility.  The old
fairy tale that a woman's career will make her less of a woman, less feeling, less loving, less equipped
to be a giving mate has never had any substance in reality.
This new state requires a strength and autonomy that needs to be earned.  It needs to be
earned by standing in life, standing in reality, and shouldering reality with all that this means.  But
you have to do so not in a spirit of hate, rebellion, competition, defiance, not by imitating the worst
excesses and distortions of manhood, the negative aggression, and the power games.  It has to be
done through the power of truth and love, from the higher self.  Whenever something real is denied
due to misconceptions, due to the false ideas that it is too difficult, those difficulties must first be
accepted before they prove themselves not so difficult at all.  Self -responsibility seems too difficult,
but really it is not, once the apparent hardships are accepted because doing so really amounts to
honesty in the approach to life.
Where distortion still exists, woman still wants from the man what she refuses to do for
herself.  In the new age woman, this will not be the case.  This does not mean that two people
sharing their life together do not also share, naturally, their difficulties.  But this is not what I am
talking about here.  You know from your path perfectly well that what you secretly wanted from a
superior father authority, you shifted onto a mate.  You also know how such an implicit desire is
bound to destroy any relationship.  It is bound to make you resent and fear the very authority you
wish to exploit in this way.  Love can only flower in a climate of true equality, where no fear exists
and therefore no defenses, no blame.  Contrary to the fairy tale that femininity blossoms when the
woman is just a servant to the man, feelings can actually only blossom when the woman is free,
autonomous, independent in the best sense of the word.  So fulfillment is completely dependent on
a true state of equality.  The moment one feels superior to the other, one's respect is lowered, and
thus the feelings close.  The moment one feels inferior to the other, resentment, fear, envy become
inescapable, and that too closes the heart.
The new woman is neither a slave to the man, nor is she in competition with him.  Therefore
she can love, and her love will never lessen her creative self -expression, but only enhance it just as
her creative contribution to life can only enhance her love capacity.  That is the new woman.
The man in the new age will no longer need a weaker mate in order not to feel his own
weakness.  The man in the new age meets his own weakness, faces it, and thereby gains his real
strength.  He realizes that his weakness is always guilt, and his self -rejection is always a denial of the
integrity of his higher self in one form or another.  Therefore the need for a slave no longer exists.
The man is then not threatened by an equal.  He does not require an inferior mate in order to
convince himself of his acceptability.  This is of course always an illusory acceptability.  Since he
faces his weakness, he must gain his strength.  Therefore his relating to the woman is truly one of
equality where he is not threatened by someone who is as creative, as adequate, as morally strong, as
intelligent as himself.  He will not need to play the master.  Again, this enables man to open his heart
and to experience a fulfillment that was previously quite impossible.  Thus, whatever vicious circles
existed will now turn into benign circles.  Instead of the inferiority feelings closing the heart, creating
resentment and hate and therefore creating frustration and therefore creating blame toward the
other sex, the benign circle will open the heart.  The fully autonomous, self -reliant, self-responsible,

Page 5 of 8
self-actualizing man and woman have nothing to fear, to envy, to resent in the other sex.  Therefore
they can open all the channels of feelings, and therefore they can experience fulfillment and also a
sense of gratitude toward the mate.  Two equals help each other in their growth as individuals, as
man and woman.  This is the new age man, the new age woman, and the new age relationship.
And where this does not yet exist, the mere fact that you can point out the fallacies within you
-- the distorted expectations; the illusory aims; t he negative feelings that are a result of false ideas, of
misconceptions -- and that you are also aware of your stake, your negative intentionality to maintain
an inner warfare, that in itself will give you an entirely different stand toward yourself and toward
the other.  So the new age man and the new age woman are not necessarily perfect and totally
developed individuals.  However, they are individuals who look for the pitfalls, for the reason for
their lack of fulfillment just as much in themselves as in the other and thus can recognize a negative
mutuality and interaction that can be worked out together.  They do not assume the stance of
self-righteous blame to widen the gap between the self and other, between the self and truth.
Autonomy is an ever growing process which makes distrust disappear.  The distrust that still exists
between the sexes is a residue of the ancient times when anything that was foreign and different was
feared, rejected, and an attempt was made to subdue it.  In the new age, differences will no longer
induce fear.  When the universe is trusted, difference always possesses a special attraction.  When
you do not fear difference but are attracted by it, you are fully actualizing yourself and dissolving
blocks of untruth; you realize your highest potentials.  But when that is not the case and you fear
and distrust the difference and deny that which is different, then you can use this as a gauge of how
you wish to remain in untruth and suffering.
In the present state of humanity's consciousness, you find on many levels all these different
stages of development.  The highest form may already exist in your consciousness to some degree.
You may in your conscious thinking truly embrace some of these ideas I have expressed here.  But
then there are also deeper levels where your emotional reactions do not at all agree with the ideas
you consciously embrace.  It does no good to postulate the conscious ideals of these ideas without
also seeing where you yourself deviate from them and how you deviate from them.  For that is the
only way to safeguard against imbalance and disharmony within and therefore also against creating it
outside.  The next lecture will deal with the topic of balance and harmony, generally speaking.
There is of course one key to everything that exists, and that key is love.  Without that key,
nothing could be mended, nothing could unify, no truth could ever be gained.  And yet it is equally
true to say that love cannot be gained without truth.  In a deep corner in the heart of man and
woman, hate and fear still prevail; resentments and distrust still prevail.  But even more importantly,
the will to maintain this state, the intentionality to perpetuate and hide this fact prevents the
flowering of the heart and the mind of man and woman.  To the degree that this is so, you have not
gained yourself and you are not able to relate to the other and fulfill yourself.  To attempt such
relating and fulfillment while this attitude is unchanged is sheer waste, is utterly futile.
So, I say to you, my dearest friends, find that corner in your heart, that small hidden crevice
where you hate the other sex.  And where you also defend yourself against recognizing this by
blaming, accusing, resenting, and closing your heart and your feelings with apparent justification.
The woman will use the game of victimization, the man will use the game of blame and superiority.
He will blame her for exploiting and using him and feel superior to that part in the woman that
makes her weak.

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 229 (An Unedited Lecture)
Page 6 of 8
Temporarily the pendulum has swung into the opposite extreme.  The woman has become
militant, thereby often forgetting her heart and her love for the man and rejecting the attitude of
loving.  In the countermovement of the pendulum, man has left his positive aggression behind and
has expressed in this evolutionary movement a weakness he would never have let himself expose in
previous eras.
All these contrary deviations have a purpose.  It is to find the true centered state.  As I said
before, man will now find his real strength.  He had to leave the false strength, the false superiority
behind.  He had to go temporarily into overt weakness, and he is now coming into a new strength, a
strength that is able to face the weakness.  Thereby he expands the real values and the real force in
him.  Therefore he does not need to be the superior member of the team.  He can afford to let his
heart speak and relate from the heart on the feeling level to his partner.  He can likewise relate on a
level of equality with his mind to the mind of his woman.  That is the man of the new age.
For this to happen, my dearest friends, you need to go into this deeper part of you where you
do not want to forgive, where you do not want to understand the truth and where you want to
preserve your case and go on hating.  You need to release the hatred toward the other sex.  You
have to pray for this ability to love, to forgive, to understand, and to see that what you hate and fear
and distrust exists in you in exactly the same way -- though perhaps manifesting in a different way.
The woman is as much a representation of the active principle as the man.  And the man is as
much a representation of the receptive principle as the woman.  In their coming together in sexual
union, this may not always express outwardly in the same way, but the inner forces must combine
both the active and receptive principles.  Otherwise imbalance exists.  No true man can be a man
unless he incorporates the receptive or, as it is called, the feminine principle.  If he only expresses
the masculine principle, he becomes a caricature of a man.  He is then a bully, a tyrant, an
exaggeration, a falsehood.  By the same token, a woman who only expresses the receptive principle
is a caricature of a woman and is truly an infant who leans on others, who negates her autonomy.
So, in order to be fully receptive on the feeling level, she has to express the active principle every bit
as much as the man.
The two principles must be represented in both and must complement one another while they
are at times also parallel.  This perfect balance cannot be thought out through the mind or through
an intellectual decision.  It can only be found organically through the inner act of love, the inner act
of releasing the other sex from the bondage of hate, distrust, and blame.  When this release is
pronounced in daily meditation, when God's grace can go to work within the consciousness of the
woman as well as of the man, then love will lead to truth just as much as truth will lead to love.  And
the two sexes will function as equally productive human beings in the new universe, complementing
and aiding one another, loving one another, respecting one another, and creating a new world, side
by side creating bliss for each other.  This is the way.
And now, my dear ones, I'm ready for your questions.
QUESTION:  (inaudible)

ANSWER:  You may have noticed a pattern on this path, my friends, in which it invariably
happens that an individual must first resolve his career problems before partnership problems can
truly be resolved.  In the context of this lecture, this will become very clear.  When relationships are
formed to act out dependency, parasitism, exploitation of the other, and/or the need to dominate
and enslave; then, for a while, these individuals have to fend for themselves until a certain minimal
autonomy and independence is established.  Once this creative channel is established, a new
freedom can release previously trapped energies, and people can begin to relate to the other sex in
an entirely new way.
I was very happy to give you this lecture, for everything that leads toward the further
unfoldment of the whole person -- man and woman -- is a joyful experience for us in our world.  See
the beauty of the Christ that goes through all of you.  Be in peace, be your God.

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 230
An Unedited Lecture
April 9, 1975
THE UNIVERSALITY OF CHANGE -- REINCARNATIVE PROCESS
IN THE SAME LIFE SPAN
Greetings, my very beloved friends here.  Again we are gathered together so as to exchange
through my giving to you where the need is greatest and through your receiving where your need is
greatest.  You thus fulfill a universal need.  This universal need is the constant movement toward
expansion.  All organisms in the entire created universe move toward that expansion that is innate,
that follows the seed plan within the organism.
What is the seed plan?  It is truly allowing divine substance to infiltrate all that is.  And that
substance is never static.  It contains limitless possibilities for being, for expression, for creative
manifestation in literally limitless ways of joyousness, of ecstasy, of wisdom -- to such an extent that
it cannot even be put into human language.  Wherever this movement is stopped, a break in
consciousness and energy occurs.
On the human level of development, for example, this break manifests in the process of
death.  But it is only a break.  Consciousness and energy are resumed, as it were, on another level.
Just as when you sleep, there is a break in consciousness on one level, but consciousness continues
on another level.  So the break is as illusory -- it only occurs on the manifest level -- as the fear of
movement.
Movement toward expansion implies a willingness to change.  And this is what we are truly
concerned with at this particular juncture on your path.  You all know that there is a
countermovement in the human soul, and that is fear of change.  Many of you are quite capable of
connecting with the fear of change.  And I say to you, it is equally important to connect with the
deeper movement, the deeper expression of your soul that constantly moves toward change.  Fuller
self-expression means change.  If there is no change, there cannot be self-expression.
Let us take this first purely on the physical level so as to demonstrate the principle.  A physical
organism constantly goes through phases and periods of change.  That change at first may be so
subtle and gradual that it is hardly noticeable, but cumulatively it becomes very noticeable indeed.
Just consider the drastic change of an infant growing into childhood, then into adolescence, and
later into adulthood.  Think of how the physical organs, the body, the whole appearance change in
the course of the years from infant to child to adolescent to adulthood to old age, and then a further
metamorphosis takes place.  This is already beyond the human vision.
So there are cycles of change which, if they were hindered, result in atrophy and finally in
death.  Let us suppose you put a human organism into such a constricted space that its further
organic movements are hindered.  It is very easy to imagine how this would affect the organism.  It
would be an antilife process.

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 230 (An Unedited Lecture)
Page 2 of 8
It is no different with the psychic organism, the spiritual organism, the mental and emotional
organism.  Yet human consciousness has created a mass image of very old origin so deeply
embedded in the human psyche that it still needs to be eradicated.  That mass image says that
change is to be feared.  This image creates a condition in the human psyche that can be likened to a
physical restriction which prevents the human organism from its natural expansion.  The space
provided by the image is so narrow that this natural expansive movement cannot occur.
The belief that this mass image perpetuates is that only an unchanging condition is secure.
Now, my friends, this mass image is extremely strong and so profound in its significance and its
effect that it is indeed responsible for the creation of death.  For you cannot experience life in any
other way but according to your conviction.  I have mentioned this many, many times throughout
the years of our contact.  But still this principle is vastly overlooked.  And still the tendency exists to
view the world in reverse or upside down.  You mistakenly take certain phenomena as though they
were inevitable, and you then see what is actually the effect as the cause.  In other words, you see
death -- it is an unknown appearance, an unknown phenomenon -- and you then conclude your fear
of change is a result of this unknown phenomenon.  In reality your fear of death is the effect of the
belief that change leads into the unknown and must therefore be feared.  The unknown is viewed
exclusively as something negative and fearsome.
If you believe change is fearsome, you will atrophy the spiritual and psychic musculature of
your system and box yourself into a state of non -movement and non-expansion in which you hardly
breathe in order not to allow change to take place.  And that is literally, to some varying degree, the
human condition.  So it is extremely important for you, my friends, who are the pioneers of the new
age, to create the new consciousness within you that does not fear change, that trusts change as a
completely natural and desirable phenomenon.
If you examine your consciousness, you will always find in one way or another a blind reaction
that expresses the belief that you must not move in order not to endanger yourself.  Trust in life is
just the opposite.  You need to begin deliberately, intentionally, and consciously to conceive of
change as a desirable and joyful movement in which you claim further realization of joyous
experience.  I would like you to remember these words and indelibly imprint them upon your soul
substance.  As you do this, you will no longer halt the natural movement to follow your own fuller
self-expression into more unity within, into more peace, into more serenity, into more joy, into more
creativity, into more wholeness.
Time itself is an illusion that, as I stated recently, stems from the ongoing movement of all
that is alive.  Time is also a product of the belief that the future must be avoided and the past held
on to in order not to cease existing.  It is your innate false belief, the innate false belief of all
mankind.  Only when man alters this belief with courage and faith will the manifestations of time
and death change, and also in this realm.  It always requires courage, the taking of an apparent risk,
to have the faith to believe in something new, something positive.  By allowing to flow with the
movement of life, you will increasingly within your lifetime expand your positive experience of life.
As you thus gain trust in the universe in which you dwell, in which you operate as an integral part, so
will you trust that which now seems mysterious -- although it may actually be mysterious by virtue of
being unknown and new -- does not hold threats for you.

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 230 (An Unedited Lecture)
Page 3 of 8
Imagine a life in which there is no fear of death.  How would you live?  If you are a highly
developed, conscious, and God-expressing individual, no fear of death would mean unending joy, a
fearless existence in which you bring the innate potentials of your divinity to ever greater expression.
But if you are still half asleep and if you therefore fear universal life or expanding, moving, changing
into universal life, then no fear of death would perhaps make you even lazier and less motivated to
move and to develop and to experience.
Now I am not saying here that fear of death is given you as a tool with which to manipulate
you into further initiative.  But I say to you that the fear of death that you have created through your
fear of moving and changing can also become its own medicine.  It then works for you in a
self-healing way.  I have explained this before as one of the most remarkable man ifestations of the
benign nature of creation: the evil unwittingly or wittingly created by individual entities becomes the
very agent with which evil heals itself.  All self-produced errors and the resulting fears, suffering, and
negativities can, if so chosen, become your means of coming out of that state.
As you grow and overcome distrust of change, you will no longer prohibit yourself from
changing and developing and expanding.  Then you shall experience the universe and life as
intensely trustworthy, desirable, beautiful, and secure.  What you feared in the tomorrow will have
become a joyous today.  Therefore, what is behind the curtain of so -called death need not be feared
even if it is unknown.  Other life experiences that lay once in the unknown future have now become
a joyous present.  Consequently, you will now also trust the unknown future.
As you cease fearing future death, this new attitude becomes more known in your innermost
being, in your intuitive perception.  So as you expand and as you grow, my friends, not only do you
become whole and acclimatized to intense, joyous self -expression; you completely lose the fear of
changing.  You visualize change as the most positive, desirable state possible.  You may not even
know exactly how joyous the tomorrow can be, but your visualization and the emotional climate are
one of trust and desire to move into this change, to experience yourself in a new and different way
that is forever more desirable, more renewed, more alive, more interesting, more fascinating.  And as
the threat of tomorrow is taken away through your new attitude even though tomorrow is not
known as yet, you intuitively experience the non -threatening aliveness of your soul, beyond your
physical existence.  Thus fear of death becomes totally eliminated in the person who realizes himself,
his God nature, and who therefore does not block the change that is joyfully waiting within every
one of your cells -- the physical as well as the psychic cells.
So I say to you, my beloved friends, do not halt the movement that is innately an expression
of life -- of natural life.  Allow it to unfold in confidence, for nothing but good can come from it if
you visualize it as such.  But if you visualize change as bad, that very idea must bring it about.  So
begin to visualize your change as good, as joyful and secure, as interesting and alive, as serene and
exciting.
For those of you who fully encourage this movement -- have the courage to encourage it, to
not halt it, have the wisdom to recognize the folly of fearing it -- to those of you I say: you already
begin to overcome death.  You begin to overcome death not only in the sense I spoke before, that
the fearsome unknown ceases to be fearsome and is trusted and therefore eventually intuitively
perceived -- a state you cannot now imagine -- but you also overcome death in another, much more

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 230 (An Unedited Lecture)
Page 4 of 8
direct sense.  About this I would like now to speak, for it is a new concept I have not touched upon
before, and it is time for you to comprehend it and to take it into your consciousness.
The concept and truth of reincarnation is discussed and taken for granted.  There are many
theories about it.  As you know, I am, as a rule, quite reluctant to speak about past or future lives.
But there is one phenomenon that I would like to discuss here and that is usually completely
neglected or denied in spiritual teachings.  A person who is truly on a path of accelerated
development can and frequently does literally reincarnate in the same lifetime .  Before incarnation,
you plan, as you know and as I have explained, a task for yourself.  You plan a certain environment,
certain conditions, certain fulfillments that you set for yourself as a task with the aid of spiritual
advisers who are equipped to help you in the planning.  Now there are many, many human beings
who barely arrive at fulfilling this task.  And many return with the task unfulfilled and have to come
back into a new embodiment to try again, perhaps this time with different conditions.  This you
know.  This I have discussed.
But another, quite different phenomenon is also possible.  And that is when a human being
fulfills the task and is then ready through such an accelerated path to take on a further task that
would ordinarily come in a new embodiment after the old body is left behind, after spending some
so-called time not in the body.  Thus a new incarnation can be undertaken without leaving the old
body behind and creating a new body.  This laborious change and break in consciousness can be
eliminated if the personality is truly devoted to give all of itself to his own fulfillment and expansion
and to his capacity to change its inherent seed plan, even the seed plan that would ordinarily be
brought to fruition only in what you would term a new incarnation.  It can be done within the same
life span.  The life that would be terminated at an earlier period can then be extended, and the new
seed plan can be "taken out" and become the task within this life span.  Or, a life that might have
continued in very different circumstances -- according to the premises of the old plan -- completely
changes in conditions, feelings, expressions, experiences, environment, and task.  New talents may
manifest, and old ones modify and express differently.  Thus a new task fulfillment can take place in
the same incarnation.
Now, I say that a path such as this one you have chosen is indeed a very rare and intense one.
And you can, all or most of you, truly feel when this is possible.  Some of you may already connect
intuitively with a complete change in your life manifestation, in your life experience so that other
potentialities that would have remained dormant in the incarnation you were born into can now
come to the fore.  With less development, these potentialities would remain to be expressed only in
a future lifetime.
When this happens, it is a wonderful occurrence.  It is an acceleration of the movement in a
very organic way.  And I say to you, in this period of extended energetic influx of the Christ
consciousness in the new age, there are more individuals who, through this influx, open themselves
up to it.  When you do not oppose it, when you do not shrink away from it, when you trust it and go
with it, you can indeed bring forth a second incarnation within one embodiment.
I would now like to suggest to you a very active meditation and visualization in which you
trust change as the most desirable, positive, brilliant, and joyful phenomenon that you want to go
with and not stem against.

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 230 (An Unedited Lecture)

A further suggestion to be considered in this meditation has to do with the familiar.  You feel
safe on familiar territory even though this territory may realistically be less safe than the unfamiliar
one.  So it frequently happens that a person remains in a very constricted and confined
circumference in order to avoid the imagined danger of the unfamiliar.  A full life always means to
step beyond the old fences and make new territory your own familiar ground in which you soon feel
as comfortable as in the old.  Realizing yourself means feeling comfortable in a new self -expression.
That is the task.  And only the first few whiffs of the new experience are unfamiliar.  Soon the new
becomes the familiar, and you expand your circumference.  You expand the territory of your psychic
"at-homeness" until yet further realms wait to be made your own, until finally all of the universe, all
of the states of consciousness and the states of mind are truly your own, intensely familiar.  Then
you are one with the universe.
Now, are there any questions in regard to this topic?
QUESTION:  The concept of reincarnation in the same life is very moving, very touching.
What I want to ask you is, in such a process is the person aware of it?  Are there any physical signs?
Does it occur in sleep or in a waking state?
ANSWER:  It occurs in a gradual way on the outer level that may not be immediately sensed
or perceived by the individual.  But there is definitely a change.  The change is instigated by the soul
in the spirit world in the state of sleep in which discussions with the spiritual advisers always take
place when a person is on a developmental path and therefore in touch with his origins and with his
advisers.  So this is discussed and planned on another level of reality.  On the manifest, physical
level, you may experience it first as a gradual process, a gradual change of attitudes, interests,
activities, environment, expression, etc.  Later on, retrospectively, as a cumulative process, you see
that your life has become very different.  But the difference is realized not in an abrupt way, but in a
gradual way.  Sometimes there is crisis, deep crisis that indicates the changeover, but this crisis is in
principle no different from physical death and rebirth.  They, too, are often crises for those who are
still in a dim state of consciousness.  It is of course less traumatic in one way in that there is no cut
in consciousness that has to be laboriously regained through a searching effort.  And that is the great
advantage of reincarnation in the same life.
QUESTION:  In this type of reincarnation within the same life, do different aspects of the
entity come forth?
ANSWER:  Yes, aspects that were not called forth in the first incarnation of that particular
lifetime.  New aspects may awaken that may never have manifested in this same lifetime.  On the
other hand, aspects that were particularly emphasized in the incarnation that took place first may
then die down after the secondary rebirth.  They are no longer of interest, they no longer serve a
purpose, they are now put aside.  They may have fulfilled their function.  Therefore the personality
loses interest in them.  This is why a person sometimes completely changes his sphere of interest in
the course of such a spiritual path.  That may indeed indicate such an incarnatory process, but not
necessarily.  It may also be that the person had first veered off from his original plan but later
became sufficiently open to sense it, and thus he changed course.  It may also be that the same
talents and interests reappear, perhaps having improved very much or directed into a different
expression.

QUESTION:  Can you tell us why, with the influx of the new Christ consciousness energy,
this process has become so accelerated?
ANSWER:  Because the energy is extremely strong.  The energy expresses the highest caliber
of consciousness, of purity, of love, of development.  It is of such a high rate of frequency that it
can be beneficially experienced only by these souls, consciousnesses, and personalities who are
compatible with it.  This is why, otherwise, this same energy creates crisis -- negative manifestations.
If you stem against it, if you fear its influx and contract against it, it will appear to be a negative
force, yet it is the highest, most potently beautiful, loving, and wise force -- which only shows once
again that one and the same thing can be experienced in entirely different ways.  It depends on the
consciousness, on the perceptions and conceptions, on the expectations and outlook of the
individual in question.
QUESTION:  Is it possible for two different aspects of the same entity to reincarnate in one
lifetime simultaneously?  Two different personalities in two different bodies, being part of the same
entity?
ANSWER:  My friends, if you really look at it in a deeply truthful and realistic way: everyone
is an aspect of the same Entity.  That is the truth.
QUESTION:  Is it possible that fear of life is really a fear of dying and reincarnation within
this life -- the process of giving up the old and moving on to the new?
ANSWER:  Yes, that is what I said in this lecture.  Life is an intensely, constantly moving
phenomenon.  Therefore it is constantly changing.  Now, if change is feared, then life is feared and,
naturally, death is feared as well.  Death is only one aspect of life.  It must be feared as much as life.
They always go together.  Change and movement mean constantly dying from an old state into a
new one but always taking aspects of the old along in renewed form and manifestation.  He who
completely accepts and embraces life cannot fear death, and vice versa.  It is one and the same
phenomenon; therefore one and the same attitude must prevail about life, death, change, movement.
QUESTION:  Concerning my recent crisis, I have connected with what you said in this
lecture, and I'd like to know whether this is actually a rebirth for me at this point?
ANSWER:  My dearest friends, all of you, this question I will never answer.  It is something
you have to experience intuitively within and know and feel within and never need a confirmation
from without.
QUESTION:  When you speak of change or the fear of change, I seem to react differently.  I
have always been attracted to change and have always been afraid of static situations.  I see that for
me this is a way of running away.  Could you comment on this?
ANSWER:  This kind of desire for change, as you describe it, is very often the misinterpreted
desire for the organic, real inner change that the personality denies.  Just because it is feared in its
real and deeper sense and because this fear causes stagnation, change on a more superficial level is
sought as a substitute.

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 230 (An Unedited Lecture)

QUESTION:  During this lecture I had this image of another being, like me, existing beyond

ANSWER:  Of course that is what it is all about.  The higher self is always there, and you can

All right, my dearest and most beloved friends, perhaps all of you sense from the nature of
tonight's topic how much you have grown and are growing and are moving toward a new area
within your inner universe, ready for further self -expression, ready to seek change as something to
cherish and trust.  Visualize yourself in that way so that you can become more fully active as the
carriers of this new, bright culture.  The new person coming to live and function in this new age is
one who never fears change, who constantly is ready for change, but not out of fear and escape or
lack of full commitment to the depth of the now, to settling down into what is.  But in this full
commitment, in this peaceful "nowness" in which you give your fullest to whatever it is you are
doing, to all of yourself, to all of your activities.  You intuitively sense the inner rhythm, the inner
cycle of movement with which you harmoniously flow.  Thus you no longer need the old outer
structure in which what is right now must unquestioningly be right tomorrow or next year.  In your
new age community, you learn already and will continue to see that what is right for now may still be
right tomorrow, but it may not be right and organic the day after tomorrow.  And it may even
already change tomorrow.  There are no rules.  Only your connectedness with your greater reality,
with your higher self can make you aware of when such change is true and when it is an evasion.  As
with everything else, so with change -- it can manifest in a divine, rhythmic way that is utterly
organic or can be, as I said in answer to a question before, a superficial substitute because the real
change is avoided.  Only when you constantly look for your connectedness with your highest
wisdom and are committed to it will you know the organic rightness of when and how changed
expressions are within the seed plan of the particular organism (group organism or individual one),
when change is desirable, productive, creative, and furthering your own self in cohesion with the
universe.
With this, my very dearest ones, I bless you once again.  Love and gratitude of the spiritual
universe is coming forth to all of you who give of yourself to yourself and thus to the greater
venture.  Be blessed, all of you!

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 231
An Unedited Lecture
May 7, 1975
NEW AGE EDUCATION
Greetings, my dearest friends, blessed be every one of you here.  We are assembled together in
order to create truth and light.  Tonight's lecture will deal with education in the new age  -- the age
that is coming, that is pushing into the resistant matter of the old that does not want to yield easily.
And yet it must yield.  This new age must create, will create human beings of the highest caliber in
every respect.  A certain percentage of the spirits incarnated is ready for a completely new approach
to life -- the approach that you are learning and that you are laboriously working your way through
into the depth of your inner being.
As a fundamental prerequisite, the new age education has to make room, above all, for the
understanding that you learn from the principles on this path, for the understanding of the human
levels of consciousness and the interactions of the various levels.  As you perhaps begin to realize,
this can be taught to children -- taught not only as theory but as an experience to go through.
Education must be a two -way street.  First of all, it must bring out  what exists within the
higher self -- its uniqueness and its limitless potentials for creativit y in all sorts of different ways.
Each incarnated individual has its own unique contributions to make to the existing society.  These
potentialities need to be tapped, a channel for them created in full consciousness of the process.
The other approach is to put in the learning from outside, without which such bringing out is hardly
possible.  This two-fold approach must be considered as an always alternating process.  You cannot
draw out what is within if there is no knowledge, no concept, if no room is made for the richness of
the world that exists in the inner universe.  If the focus is not to make room for this richness, if no
tuning-in process is made available, then the channel for bringing out the inner potentials will
remain untapped.  But if you teach this tuning -in process, if you teach that there is another level of
consciousness, of awareness, little by little as you learn to do it, so will the child learn to discover the
language of the divine reality within.  The child will learn to listen, to perceive, and to bring it out.
This does not mean, however, not to learn the fundamental knowledge that all children need
to learn in the age just going by, as well as in the new age.  But now there is room only for the one,
not for the other direction.  This alternating approach is what really counts.  One must not take the
place of the other, they are both important.  One must not be cultivated at the expense of the other
as mankind so often tends to in all such matters.
If you approach the child with this double purpose, a very different process of learning and
education is going to unfold.  For the inner voice will be discerned when its laws are understood.
The learning of the laws, the pitfalls of the lower self -- so that its own voice can be distin guished --
must become a substantial aspect of the child's curriculum.  So there will be a large quota of learning
that is concerned with the inner being, with the bringing out of the higher self, with the purification
of the lower self, and with a very exact knowledge of the laws that prevail in the discernment of

both, and also in the realization of the existence of the mask self.  Education will eliminate masks
about to be formed and will start self -purification early.  Such is the groundwork for all new  age
education, learning, and creativity in whatever field.
The fundamental groundwork will be taken up not only by parents -- for there is no guarantee
that all parents are sufficiently highly developed to possess this knowledge and are thus equipped to
handle this aspect of the child's education; it must therefore also be part of the school curriculum
for all ages, starting as early as kindergarten and going into college and university.  So a large part of
education will deal -- as the fundamental road t o learning -- with the realization of the higher self.
Intellectual knowledge will then become secondary.  Not that it becomes less important or
unimportant, but it then can bring fruit.  The intellect needs to be trained and used as one of the
important tools.  For without the intellect grasping and understanding these laws and processes, the
personality cannot even begin to approach the road into the inner self.  If the mind does not know
that there even exists an inner world to find and explore, it cannot ever attempt to go in the right
direction, make the proper efforts, remove the obstructions, recognize what is obstruction and what
is an aid.  So new age education is not only a question of emotional or spiritual education.  It is truly
a perception and an understanding of lawfulness.  Just as there are chemical laws, laws of physics,
laws of mathematics for man to understand, so are these laws of the inner world to be learned and
understood.
Now there are other aspects about the education to come.  For instance, the curiosity of the
child must be cultivated  so that learning will be intensely interesting and fascinating .  Unfortunately
this is by no means the case now.  On the contrary, the child's innate curiosity is discouraged.
Children have from their earliest age millions of questions.  You all know that.  Usually parents and
teachers become annoyed, bored, and impatient.  At best they give very insufficient answers,
answers that are hardly honest, or answers that fail to take the questions and the questioner
seriously.
Now it is extremely important to cultivate this curiosity, for once it is squashed, the learning
process becomes a dull "must" that kills the spirit and the life of learning.  It can be intrinsically
exciting, enjoyable, adventurous, and it often would be if a mass image of boredom would not be
attached to it.
Parents should start in the earliest phases of the child's questioning to respect the child and
rejoice in the questions brought forth.  They do not have to try so hard and pretend to know more
than they do.  All they have to be is honest and interested.  If they really do not know an answer,
they should say so, but also tell the child that school will bring all these answers.  The child should
be encouraged to ask them again and perhaps to make note of them.  Or the parents can note them
down.  The parents can also make a concerted effort of their own to find out meaningful and
truthful answers and then come back to the child with these answers.  It must be realized that it is
the spirit of the child that reaches forth to explore this world in order to master it and fulfill a task in
it.  Without this curiosity, something dies.  So this curiosity is very important.  Parents can go to
nursery teachers, later to school teachers or other people equipped to answer such questions.  They
should really make an effort.  All questions that a young child has asked will be dealt with later in the
curriculum.  They may be pointers to the spirit's special inclinations and directions.  They should be
answered again and again as the child grows older and can take in more.

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 231 (An Unedited Lecture)

Schools will know that the spirit ventures out into the earth realm and that curiosity is the sign
of the adventurousness that made the entity want to incarnate and fulfill a task.  Approached in this
way, the material makes learning an exciting process instead of a dull, compelling, boring difficulty
that one would like to have over and done with.  Learning will become something to look forward
to.  It will offer many keys to life.  It will furnish deeply desired answers to life.
This is very important, my friends, very important for the parents who are here and for the
teachers even if you cannot as yet create a new school system, a new educational system, a new
curriculum.  But just knowing of these approaches and making room in your consciousness for them
will give you a new awareness and will create a new climate in your dealings with the growing human
being.
The next aspect I wish to talk about in regard to education is what is now for most of you still
a difficulty, and that is finding the fine balance between freedom, self -choice -- as I discussed in the
last question -and-answer session here -- and self -discipline.  Although I discussed this in other
contexts, this is equally applicable to learning and education.  The freedom to want to learn is
important.  There should be no whip behind it, if at all possible.  This depends greatly, of course, on
providing the proper climate by the consciousness of the adult world around.  If the adult harbors
an image that learning is a hardship, a boring and dull task even if he does not say so, he will affect
the child in a similar way.  If there is an attitude that assumes that learning and homework are "the
price to be paid" before pleasure can begin, it is assumed that the child will hate learning.  And then
this will be conveyed to the child, and he or she will indeed believe it and eventually find it so even if
there would have existed at first a readiness to be interested in it.
The necessity of self-discipline is great.  Without it, nothing can be gained or accomplished in
life on any level.  Freedom, spontaneity on the one hand and self-discipline on the other are not only
not mutually exclusive as most people believe, but they are in fact mutually interactive, aiding,
interconnected, and interdependent.  Since most adults suffer from this duality (that freedom and
self-discipline cancel each other out), it is inevitably transferred to the child.  This is perhaps not
done in so many words but in the climate, in the emotional expression, in the inner consciousness
that spreads and affects the child.
In this belief, freedom means to give in to the line of least resistance and thus to become
self-destructive.  Or, conversely, self -discipline then means the dullness of laborious effort without
reward.  Now, perhaps most of you, my friends, can begin to see how untrue this is, how
unnecessary such artificial divisions are, and how much burden they cause to your soul substance
and to your inner consciousness and therefore to your entire life.
You have to free yourself of this misconception on your own path just as parents and teachers
also have to do this.  They have to learn that, in fact, true freedom with all its joy, with all the
liberating self-expression can only exist to the degree that self -discipline exists also.  You have to
make a very distinct difference between discipline that is chosen by the self  and discipline that is
imposed by the outside.  Discipline imposed by the outside, if we discard tyranny, must only exist
where self-discipline is lacking, only when adults or children act destructively to their environment
or themselves.  As far as children are concerned, self -destructive acts must be discouraged by their
elders.  As far as adults are concerned, this is hardly possible or desirable, but we shall not go into
this topic now.

The concept of freely chosen self-discipline, as opposed to necessary imposed discipline when
the former is absent, can be made clear to children with the greatest of ease, without any difficulty
whatsoever.  A child is very capable of understanding that the outer discipline is a structure that is
"waiting in reserve" only.  In other words, if the child would not respond to the freedom of learning;
if he or she is not willing to understand the necessity of wanting it even if this means occasionally
overcoming a resistance, overcoming the temptation to do what seems most pleasurable at the
moment; the outwardly imposed discipline is essential for him as well as for the community.  If the
child can learn to determine for himself, then he has learned a major lesson of life.  If he learns
self-determination and self -responsibility, if he is guided into this understanding, he has gained a
profound substance and foundation.  If he can say "yes, I will do homework now and learn my
quota so and so many hours a day even though emotionally I prefer to go out and play, because I
understand that this will give me later knowledge, strength, security, success -- all the things that I
find desirable -- and I choose so freely," he has learned the lesson of real freedom very early in life.
And this is indeed possible.  Guidance can be very explicitly and implicitly given for this aspect to
grow in the child so that self -discipline is freely chosen and outer imposed discipline is no longer
necessary.  It must always exist as a structure in reserve to be used when needed.  For, of course,
even in the new age there will be individuals who are not yet developed enough to be capable of
understanding what I am saying here, and they will willfully act out in a destructive way -- children as
well as adults.
But the time will come (not during your lifetime) when outer laws will no longer exist, when
each human being will be governed by his inner law of the divine self and will know what is right for
him.  He will not kill, steal, harm, or destroy others.  But it will not be fear of punishment that
would hold him back.  And as far as laws not dealing with such crass and obvious infringements are
concerned, humanity will then know that there is no rigid rule that applies to everyone alike.  Each
one will be sufficiently united with his higher self, his conscience and integrity will be sufficiently
strong so that he will freely do what is right, what is fair, what is necessary.  But he will not do it out
of fear of disapproval.  He will not be obedient out of guilt and insecurity but will know, "this is
right for me," whether it conforms with the general masses or not.  He will be able to do so because
he will also be free from rebellion against authority and, what is more, free from secret desires to
exploit others.
Very few human beings are today anywhere near this point, so the outer structure is necessary
for those who need it.  Those who do not need it do not require to be told what to do and what not
to do.  They want to be in truth with the law of God that often is similar to human law, but not
always.  Children can learn this in very specific ways.  For example, topics that have always appeared
difficult and dull such as general learning, arithmetic, spelling, history will continue to be taught, of
course.  In most instances, however, even those topics will be much more interesting with the new
approach I mentioned here.  For the child is innately curious and wants to know many things.  If
this is fostered and those subjects approached in that way, much of the tediousness of learning will
become obsolete.  Nevertheless, there will always be times when inertia and taking the line of least
resistance must be overcome until something is really learned.  To overcome this threshold, a child
can be taught the principles I explain here about the necessity and freedom of self -discipline.  This
very fundamental understanding of self -discipline as a prerequisite for freedom will be part of the
basic education.

of the child and of his surroundings.
The process of communication is of course of major importance.  We are talking here also
about communication on two levels: on the conscious level of expressed words, of explanation, of
the highest caliber input which is true teaching; and also on the level of awareness, feeling, and inner

exists a great need for improvement in the educational system.  As a child wants to hear, listen, and
learn (when he asks questions), so does he want to be listened to.  He has a great need for that and
desires to express himself.  Not enough leeway is given to this, and too often his self -expression is
curtailed on the simplest of levels.  Encouragement to communicate his feelings, thoughts, and
impressions, and being responded to, receiving feedback, as you call it, is a very essential aspect of
the personality's unfoldment.
This is equally important on the inner level.  For a child often perceives feelings and thoughts
of others that are not openly expressed, reacts to them, but is not encouraged to take these
perceptions seriously.  Thus he cannot learn (a) that he does not fantasize, but rather he really
perceives something, (b) that sometimes his own projections may interfere with and distort the
quality of his reception.  If the law of communication is being taught early on these different levels,
the child will become aware of their reality.  And I hardly need to emphasize what an enormous
difference this will make in his life, in his dealings with himself and others.  He will neither discard
his reactions nor take them blindly at face value.  He will learn the process of investigation, of
holding final determination in reserve, of probing -- all of which will come from free self -expression
of his impression and a mutual exchange not only with teachers and parents but with other children
too.

your lower self without being devastated and totally rejected, holding your inner balance and

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 232
An Unedited Lecture
June 4, 1975
BEING VALUES VERSUS APPEARANCE VALUES -- SELF-IDENTIFICATION
Greetings and divine blessings for all of you, my most beloved friends.  May this last lecture of
this working year resume in next year's series and at the same time summarize your inner path on a
very deep level.  The growth and the change that has taken place and continues to take place with so
many of you is heartwarming and a most joyous sight to behold.  You have grown much, much
more, my beloved friends, than you can realize, for you are in the middle of it.  More of you change
over onto a new level of operation in which the old attitude of taking, wanting, demanding, and not
giving is transformed into an attitude of love, giving, devotion, and sincerity.  And that is truly the
key, the key to happiness and abundance.  There is no other key.  But to talk about it on a superficial
level before one is even aware of the non -giving attitude is pointless.  You have to travel throug h all
the levels of your lower self to recognize them before this key can become meaningful.  In this
lecture I want to show you on a yet deeper level how this relates to the problem of {value and
self-identification}.
There are fundamentally two value systems by which a human being is governed, with which
he operates.  The one is the {being values} and the other is the {appearance values}.  Now, we have
talked about this in a more superficial and cursory way.  However, I will attempt to show you in this
lecture the ramifications of these two value systems.  Most human beings function on the level of
the appearance values.  I would say it is only the most evolved who have already gone through an
extensive path of self -purification and transformation, who fu nction according to real values, {for
the sake of what is, not for the sake of appearance in the eyes of others}.  Here, too, of course, as in
so many other areas, it is not either/or.  There are degrees.  A person can function in some areas of
his life with the true values and in other areas still be bound to the importance of appearance.  And
only gradually in the course of this pathwork will the former take over more and more where the
latter had prevailed before.
To begin with, before such an extensive path is undertaken and for some time after it has
begun, humanity functions in most areas with the appearance values.  Now let us see the difference.
The appearance values always aim at the impression you give in the eyes of others.  It may
have its crasser manifestations such as aiming for approval and selling out your truth in order to
impress others or be thought of in the highest terms by them.  This can be quite obvious and overt,
but it can also be quite subtle and covert and not so easy to detect.  The inner focus is subtly geared
in many activities, desires, and directions, in a secret, hidden, semi -conscious expectation and
concern about "what will I be thought of."  The fear of negative reaction from others causes a
tremendous amount of anxiety.  So the appearance value system is insidious and poisonous.  It is
much more harmful, my friends, than it may appear.  For it truly disconnects you from your inner
reality, from your higher self, from the truth of the situation, and from the sincerity of your

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 232 (An Unedited Lecture)
Page 2 of 8
involvement and investment.  I hardly need to emphasize how many further, most harmful results
this causes.
If you start observing yourself from this point of view, you will discover the many areas that
first appear ever so subtle in your field of vision.  Yet when you become more conscious of them,
when you tune in on them, you find they are not so subtle and that actually the value system of
appearance, as opposed to the value system of {being}, makes all the difference in the world.  The
appearance values, no matter how strong and apparently loving or creative the effort and goal may
be, always connote an insincerity.  For what you do is done for effect -- either directly through the
activity or in order to attain power and money for the sole sake of proving your values.  When you
operate with {being} values it means that you do what you do for the sake of what is, for the sake of
the truth of the particular area in question, for the sake of {being}.  This may simply mean to do the
best you have to offer regardless of others' opinions but so that the activity fulfills its innate
purpose.  Or it may mean to make an offering to God out of the act or the endeavor, to contribute
love, beauty, goodwill, comfort, something constructive to the world, to another person -- again,
regardless of others' opinions or even their noticing the effort and the effect.  Whether you make an
important humanitarian contribution, a work of art, a scientific project, or the smallest, most
insignificant daily chore makes no difference.  In the latter instance, it is just as important to do
every daily activity in the spirit of being, not appearance.
When you act, work, and accomplish -- again, in large and small issues -- for the sheer sake of
what the act itself represents rather than "using" it in order to substitute your sense of self-value, this
always finally amounts to an act of love, to spiritual sincerity, to a giving and enriching act.  And
what you give to others, you give to yourself.  Not giving to others deprives you even more than it
deprives others and makes you incapable of receiving what is available for you.
When you operate on the being level, some very drastic changes occur.  These are by-products
that you might never have connected with the origin, namely the integrity of your motive on the
deepest level.  Let me give you an example.  When you are attacked or judged or criticized or
rejected, as long as you operate with the value system of appearance, you will feel devastated in your
total being.  And how can it be different?  If you attach your self-worth and your self-esteem to what
you appear in the eyes of others, you must feel annihilated when you appear in a bad light in the eyes
of others, be it in ever so small an issue.  You feel you lose your inner ground.  You are no longer
centered in yourself.  Of course, you never really are centered as long as you are governed by
appearance values, but you are deluded about this fact as long as criticism does not come to you.
You {seem} centered when you receive praise and admiration because you feel gratified at the
moment, but you are unaware of the anxiety that eats you up, even in those most propitious
moments, as long as you receive your worth from others.  For you must constantly worry about
your ability to maintain this de -centered state of receiving self -value from others.  You have no real
control over your sense of self-value.
Operating with being values, on the other hand, brings a deep inner security.  This is not to
say that hostile judgments, unfairness, and the intent to put you down would not hurt you.  But,
{there is a world of difference between this kind of hurt that can never shake your foundation and
the hurt that does shake your foundation}.  If you operate with appearance values, your foundation
is shaken and even seems to crumble when your appearance is negative.  This does not happen
when you operate in the deep security of being.  Given your total integrity and knowledge of your

real motives on the most hidden levels, the truth of your giving, the sincerity of your investment, the

may hurt you, you experience the unshakable truth of your core.  Then your value of yourself is not
dependent on the opinion of others, on their knowing your assets and ignoring your liabilities.  This
creates a centeredness and a security and an awareness of your eternal values that cannot be
esteemed in words.
Another ramification in regard to this topic is the problem of {identity}.  When you operate
with appearance values, you have no identity.  You stake your claim to your own identity on the
opinion of other people, on how you appear in their eyes.  So when you are praised and honored,
you derive a great momentary sense of gratification and confirmation of yourself and perhaps even a
temporary exhilaration, but it is built on shaky ground.  When that admiration and approval are
withheld or perhaps even reversed, the ground is shaking and you become lost.  You cease to feel
your own identity.  The false sense of your identity has been crushed, and the real has not yet been
established.
As long as appearance values hold sway, underneath the surface you constantly eat away at
your self-esteem because deep inside you know you are not in truth when you put so much on the
level of appearance.  You cannot connect with the identity of your higher self.  Since you know that
you only appear to give, doing it for ulterior motives, for something you want to gain in a prideful,
vain way; on a very deep level, you doubt yourself.  So when others doubt you, distrust you, criticize
you in any way; on the surface you may be very indignant, and you may be very defensive, and you
may be argumentative about this and that issue.  But inwardly you cannot find your center since you
doubt your integrity about the way you operate generally.  Perhaps you don't lack integrity in the
specific issue, but you have no sense of your true identity and your true value since you forsake the
true value system -- and therefore your knowing of your real identity -- by adopting the appearance
values.
Another aspect of these two possibilities of value systems that forms a permeating overall
attitude toward yourself and toward life is your ability to perceive truth in others.  And this is a very
profound and important aspect of this whole topic.  Try to go beyond the mere words which you
have heard me mention in one form or another before.  When you function in your giving, in your
activities in a deeply committed sincere spirit, then whatever you do occurs in wholehearted
investment of your best faculties.  But when this spirit is not there and the appearance values reign,
you can never really know whether you are right or wrong; whether others are right or wrong; to
what extent you are right or wrong, or are the others right or wrong; in what particular area are you
right and in what area the others are right; in what particular area are you wrong and in what way the
others are wrong.  All these questions plague you although you may succeed to deny yourself
awareness of them as you unfortunately succeed to deny yourself awareness of the fact that the
appearance values undermine your integrity.  These denials are the very cause of confusion and
create a fog over such issues and questions when you would need clarity in order to know who you
are.  So you flounder, you grope, but you do not grope in a healthy way.  You are truly confused.
You are upset, and the struggle is painful because it is a struggle that covers up the inner lack of
security that can only come from the deep sincerity of commitment and giving.  This lack of giving
and commitment eats away at your psychic guts, if I may say so.  It makes you doubtful of
everything you do, of everything you think.

you get from being connected and identified with your innermost center -- that {intuitive certainty

and a deep peace and clarity that no one can take away from you.  It is free from all defense, and it
comes only as a result of true self -esteem that is built on that very sincerity of giving a nd

By contrast, appearance values interfere with one another and are at the same time stiff, rigid,

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 233
An Unedited Lecture
September 24, 1975
THE POWER OF THE WORD
Greetings, my very beloved friends here, blessings and love envelop you and penetrate your
very core.  With joy do I resume my communication with you, although, really, this communication
has never been broken.
Most of you here can feel with clarity that you are deeply involved in a magnificent process --
the process of the spirit penetrating that which has alienated itself from the spirit.  Now, as I have
explained before, the alienated part is on its own and creates its own momentum.  It becomes
involved in this momentum, creating and recreating its own patterns.  Translated into human terms,
this means that negative creation seems to be the stronger aspect in a person's life.  He appears to be
caught in it, unable, as it were, to reverse this pattern.  You, on this path, with the work you have
done until now, begin to realize that it is indeed possible to come out of the negative pattern of
creation, of the momentum that takes hold of you as if it had an independent life of its own that has
nothing to do with you.  You seem to be its victim.  You do not realize how you very directly
created this movement that carries you of its own.
You experience and witness in the creation of the path, of your Center, that this movement is
part of a grandiose scheme that must transcend the volitional, conscious aspect of your being.  You
are now indeed engaged in a most positive momentum that is the stronger aspect, notwithstanding
the still existing presence of lower self aspects.  The higher self is becoming constantly predominant.
This is not superimposed in a wishful denial of the lower self; it is the result of a genuine
transformation well grounded in reality.  You see the fruits of this in your personal life to an ever
growing degree, and you see the fruits in the growth and expansion, in depth and width of the
community as a whole.
I want you to be very much aware of the fact that the higher purpose of this movement goes
far beyond your present life.  It is a preparation of important changes in evolution, and you are
instruments, all of you, each in your own way.  Each of you in his own way needs to realize the
importance of his task from an inner place that is not ego -involved, not in vanity or pride.  And that
is possible right now.  If you so choose, you can know the happiness of being such an instrument
for fulfilling a task for a much higher cause of the deepest significance without pride and vanity.
You can do this right now and thus further contribute to the energy and the consciousness that
create this movement.
The movement of consciousness is opposite to how human beings imagine it.  The truth is
that the dualistic, cut-off life is not "raised," as it is often  said, into higher realms of being.  This is a
reversed view, fitted to a consciousness still steeped in space and time -bound terms.  It would be
more accurate to say that higher realms come "down" and penetrate the lower realms, rather than
saying that lower realms raise themselves up into higher ones.  According to this latter concept, the

Pathwork Guide Lecture No. 233 (An Unedited Lecture)
